P.name: Void Shift
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Malzahar''' gains ''Void Shift'' until he takes non-{{tip|minion}} damage or negates a {{tip|crowd control}} effect, to which it then lingers for {{fd|0.25}} seconds before expiring.

{{sbc|Void Shift:}} '''Malzahar''' gains {{tip|Cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} and 90% damage reduction.
P.description2: ''Void Shift's'' {{sti|cooldown}} refreshes whenever '''Malzahar''' takes non-{{tip|minion}} damage or is affected by a {{tip|crowd control}} effect, and resets upon [[death|respawning]].

Q.name: Call of the Void
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' opens two portals to the void centered at the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area in between. After {{fd|0.4}} seconds, enemies between the portals are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|silence|silenced}} for a duration.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}
{{st|Silence Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}

W.name: Void Swarm
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Malzahar''' generates a stack of ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' when he casts another {{tip|ability}}, up to a maximum of 2.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' consumes all ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stacks and, after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay, summons a {{ui|Voidling}} at the target location. Additional ''Voidlings'' are then summoned for each ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stack consumed, with each ''Voidling'' being summoned {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the previous one.
W.description3: ''Voidlings'' deal {{as|magic damage}} with their attacks, reduced by 50% against epic {{tip|monsters}} and increased by 200% to enemy {{tip|minions}} infected by ''{{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}}''.

E.name: Malefic Visions
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' infects the target enemy's mind, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 4 seconds, which refreshes upon damaging them with ''{{ai|Call of the Void|Malzahar}}'' or ''{{ai|Nether Grasp|Malzahar}}''. ''Malefic Visions'' executes {{tip|minions}} if they would be damaged below {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|10 to 30 for 11}} health}}}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 220}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|80/16 to 220/16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80/16}}% AP)}}}}
E.description2: If the target dies while infected, they spread ''Malefic Visions'' onto the closest nearby enemy and '''Malzahar''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|2% of his '''maximum''' mana}}}}.

R.name: Nether Grasp
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malzahar''' {{tip|tether|tethers}} to the target enemy champion, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}}. He then {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} the target and dealing them {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself in the process.
R.leveling: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|125/10 to 275/10}} {{as|(+ 8% AP)}}}}
R.description2: '''''Malzahar''' will continue to channel as long as the tether is not broken, even if the suppression is removed.''
R.description3: Additionally, a ''Null Zone'' is opened beneath the target's location at the time of cast that lasts 5 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to enemies within, capped at 120 per tick against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
R.leveling3: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|10 to 20}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|10/10 to 20/10}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
R.description4: ''Null Zone will persist even if the channel is interrupted.
